name: claude-trellis-skill-resolution
title: Claude skill copies drop the Claude-specific resolution guidance their command adapters carry
description: The generator's Claude-only rewrites reach command adapters but not skill copies. claude_adapter() (generate-command-surfaces.py:593) applies CLAUDE_COMMAND_ALIAS_REWRITES (:101) and OVERRIDE_BODIES (:158) when emitting templates/.claude/commands/sd/*.md, while _platform_skill_entry() (:744) copies templates/.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md verbatim to <platform>/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with no rewrite hook. So .claude/commands/sd/{finish-work,continue}.md carry "resolving trellis:finish-work counts as resolving this skill" and .claude/commands/sd/start.md carries the SessionStart note, but .claude/skills/sd-{finish-work,continue,start}/SKILL.md are byte-identical to their neutral sources and carry neither. An agent that loads the skill therefore follows "resolve trellis-finish-work by name, else stop" with no mention of the installed Claude form. The pack's Claude bridge itself is deliberate and documented (templates/docs/SD_AI_COMMAND_PACK.md:194-198); only its delivery to the skill surface is missing. sd-review-pr is not a fourth direct resolver -- it resolves sd-finish-work (.claude/skills/sd-review-pr/SKILL.md:738) and tests/test_sdlc_commands.py:452-453 forbid direct trellis-finish-work resolution there -- so it needs transitive regression coverage only. Implementation must first choose between transforming Claude skill output, moving the guidance into the neutral body shared by eleven skill platforms (registry.py:475-487), or dropping the redundant Claude skill entrypoints. Observed 2026-08-07 in a real sd-finish-work run in loadsmith, where the agent improvised around the dependency and reported a false blocker.
